profile.headline: Professional Software Engineer
profile.summary: Highly competent programmer analyst with over 20 years of experience.  Proficient in COBOL, DB2, SQL, CICS, and JCL.  Provides high quality work, has excellent interpersonal and communication skills, and is effective at consistently completing projects within time and budget.

positions.title: Professional Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Attention to Detail · Communication · Confidentiality

positions.title: Specialist
positions.description: Technical Lead on various projects and systems.  Active in all steps of the Project Development Process.  Researched legacy COBOL Retail Pricing Reports to write requirements for third party (BRdata) replacement project.  Managed the implementation of special customizations for new member store chain by analyzing, designing, writing specs, assisting in coding COBOL DB2 programs, changing JCL, unit testing, system testing and implementation.  Researched legacy COBOL/CICS to prepare for retirement once BRdata Retail Pricing replacement is implemented.

positions.title: Analyst II
positions.description: Lead and support programmer/analyst for multiple systems.  Worked on a team implementing a third party Demantra application for Retail Pricing using Oracle databases and PL/SQL programming.

positions.title: Analyst
positions.description: Support programmer for multiple development projects across various applications.  Integral member of team converting all systems to use a 2 digit facility number.

positions.title: Mainframe Developer
positions.description: Contract programmer for the Two-Digit Facility Expansion Project.  Made programming changes for CICS online programs, COBOL and COBOL/DB2 batch programs, and JCL.  Performed unit and system testing for various applications.

positions.title: Mainframe Developer
positions.description: Contract programmer at JPMorgan Chase.  Tech lead for Retirement Plan Services Paperless Confirms project.  Wrote technical specs, coded new development and program enhancements, and unit tested project changes that removed the formatting of the reports from the programs and created data files loaded to DB2 that are extracted and sent to an outside print vendor for mailing or email notification.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: Lead and support programmer for the Portfolio Accounting System. Lead a team of five on the Canadian Media Transmission project which allowed users to select needed funds, thru GUI screens, that we gathered data on and transmitted the data using FTP to various selected pricing agencies.  Used COBOL, DB2, SQL, CICS, VSAM, and Datacom on new development and support projects. Responsibilities included designing, writing project plans, writing test scripts, coding, unit testing, alpha testing, and installing projects into production.
positions.insights: Skills: Job Control Language (JCL) · COBOL · CICS · VSAM · SQL · Confidentiality · FTP · IBM Db2

positions.title: Senior Systems Analyst
positions.description: Provided new development and support programming for the order management and replenishment systems and the integration of the Outdoor coalition using CICS, COBOL, DB2, SQL, IDMS, IDMS/SQL, and CSP.  Responsibilities also included being in charge of the implementation of major projects into production.
positions.insights: Skills: Job Control Language (JCL) · COBOL · CICS · IDMS · SQL · CSP · IBM Db2

positions.title: Staff Consultant
positions.description: Worked as a contract programmer for OTI/SRI (Output Technologies Inc./Systems Resources Inc.) which is a subsidiary of DST.  Provided lead and support programming for the Investor MIMS product, which creates financial statements for investment companies.  OTI/SRI uses their own in-house language (Rules) that is loaded and executed through DB2 tables. Responsibilities included coding enhancements to existing statements and setting up, coding, and installing new statement applications.

positions.title: Computer Systems Analyst
positions.description: Lead analyst for the designing, programming, and maintenance of Tax and Regulatory applications, PC and mainframe.  Headed up all projects associated with Tax and Regulatory reporting requirements for the states of Wyoming and North Dakota.  Project leader for the conversion of the printer forms flash hardware to utilize the 3900 printer software features.  Provided lead and support programming for the controller applications including Invoice Control and Processing and Lease Masters.
positions.insights: Skills: Job Control Language (JCL) · COBOL · CSP · IMS-DC · IBM Db2
